name: Summon Manu
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [good]; Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 9, cleric/oracle 9, witch 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, F/DF (a burning fire and clarified butter)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one summoned manu manasaputra
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like summon monster, except that it summons a single manu manasaputra.
